The third pig of the front row ## stands out. big_pig_herd : PigHerd.BigPigHerd big_pig_herd = { columns_before_standout: 2, columns_after_standout: 4, rows_behind_front: 6, } ## The route's cow herd, fourteen cows in columns of three. cow_herd : CowHerd cow_herd = CowHerd.herd({ cow_count: 14, rows_behind_front: 2 }) ## How many of the segments before `index` have pigs. herd_count_before : Route.SegmentIndex -> U64 herd_count_before = |index| World.segment_plans .take_first(index.count_before()) .count_if(|plan| plan.pigs == WithPigs) route_segment_at : U32 -> Segment route_segment_at = |i| World.route.segment_at(Route.SegmentIndex.number(i)) expect [ (0, False), (17, False), (18, True), ].all(|(index, want)| is_last_segment(route_segment_at(index)) == want) # The rider commits to the route's end at the end of its last segment. expect route_segment_at(18).commit_along().to_metres() == 300.0 expect [ (route_segment_at(0).commit_along().to_metres(), 498.32180073764545), (route_segment_at(1).commit_along().to_metres(), 319.2720595314676), (route_segment_at(6).commit_along().to_metres(), 1199.647346038583), ].all(|(got, want)| (got - want).abs() <= 0.00000001) # Each cat crosses by a tree that is really there. expect [3, 9, 18].all( |index| { cat_tree = crossing_at(index).tree() route_segment_at(index).trees.any(|tree| tree.road_point == cat_tree) }, ) # Every segment is longer than zero. Route.segments_with_ends and each bend's geometry # measure from it. expect World.segment_plans.all(|plan| plan.length > Distance.zero) # Every bend really turns the road off its line. BendInView.outer_corner crashes on # a bend that turns 0 or 180 degrees. expect World.bending_plans.all(|{ turn, .. }| !turn.is_straight_or_back()) # Each encounter's animal waits before its segment's commit_along, because # EncounterPlan.plan_at_next_step forgets the plan once the rider leaves the segment. expect World.route.route_segments().all( |segment| match segment.encounter.encounter_span() { Ok({ planned_along, .. }) => planned_along < segment.commit_along() Err(QuietRoad) => True }, ) # Every pig and cow stands on its own segment, between its start and its length, where # Segment's pig_distance_before_end and cow_herd_along mean to place the herds. expect World.route.route_segments().all( |segment| { is_on_segment = |placed| { along = placed.road_point.along.from_start() along >= Distance.zero and along <= segment.length } segment.segment_pigs().all(is_on_segment) and segment.segment_cows().all(is_on_segment) }, ) ## Whether `segment` ends the route. is_last_segment : Segment -> Bool is_last_segment = |segment| match segment.ending { Bends(_) => False RouteEnds => True } ## The cat crossing at a segment that has one. crossing_at : U32 -> CatCrossing crossing_at = |index| match route_segment_at(index).encounter { CatCrosses(crossing) => crossing BirdHere(_) | QuietRoad => crash "World.crossing_at: the segment has a cat" }

name: canvas_apps/shapes_widget/ShapesWidgetApp.roc
html: ## The pictures for the Safari tutorial's first look at shapes: a triangle, ## then a rectangle, each on a plain background. The Right key steps from one ## to the other, which is how the page opens at each. import lib.Pixels import lib.Point import lib.Brush import lib.CanvasApp import lib.Input import lib.RgbColor import lib.Shapes import widget.WidgetPage import widget.WidgetPalette ShapesWidgetApp :: [].{ ## Which shape the picture shows. Model : [Triangle, Rectangle] canvas_app : CanvasApp.CanvasApp(ShapesWidgetApp.Model) canvas_app = { size: { width: WidgetPage.canvas_width, height: canvas_height }, frames_a_second: WidgetPage.fixed_picture_frames_a_second, init: Triangle, model_at_next_step: CanvasApp.untimed_model_at_next_step(next_model), frame_shapes: shapes_of, sounds: |_model| 0, tones: [], title: "A triangle and a rectangle", } ## A green triangle. green_triangle : Shapes.Shape green_triangle = Triangle({ first: Point.at(180.0, 262.0), second: Point.at(420.0, 262.0), third: Point.at(300.0, 42.0), fill: Brush.flat(RgbColor.of(0x2e8b57)), }) ## A brown rectangle. brown_rectangle : Shapes.Shape brown_rectangle = Shapes.rectangle({ top_left: Point.at(240.0, 82.0), width: Pixels.of(120.0), height: Pixels.of(160.0), fill: Brush.flat(RgbColor.of(0x8b5a2b)), }) } ## A little shorter than the usual widget page, since one shape needs less room ## around it. canvas_height : F64 canvas_height = 324.0 ## The picture after one frame: the Right key shows the other shape. next_model : ShapesWidgetApp.Model, Input.Snapshot -> ShapesWidgetApp.Model next_model = |shown, input| if input.key_pressed(KeyRight) { match shown { Triangle => Rectangle Rectangle => Triangle } } else { shown } ## Everything on the canvas: the background, then the shape shown. shapes_of : ShapesWidgetApp.Model -> List(Shapes.Shape) shapes_of = |shown| { shape = match shown { Triangle => ShapesWidgetApp.green_triangle Rectangle => ShapesWidgetApp.brown_rectangle } [WidgetPage.picture_backdrop(WidgetPalette.picture_background_color), shape] } expect shapes_of(Triangle) == [ WidgetPage.picture_backdrop(WidgetPalette.picture_background_color), ShapesWidgetApp.green_triangle, ] expect next_model(Triangle, Input.none.with_key_pressed(KeyRight)) == Rectangle expect next_model(Rectangle, Input.none.with_key_pressed(KeyRight)) == Triangle expect next_model(Triangle, Input.none) == Triangle
